items.question: Can I choose who comes?
items.answer: Yes. Turn on applications, ask your own questions, and approve, decline or waitlist each person. Approved guests pay to confirm.

items.question: How does the seating plan work?
items.answer: {{brand.name}} suggests tables from your guest list, keeping friends who booked together side by side. Move anyone with a tap, and keep people apart if you need to.

items.question: What if someone cancels?
items.answer: Refunds follow the cancellation policy you set. If there’s a waitlist, the next person gets an offer for the seat.

items.question: Do guests need an app?
items.answer: No. Guests apply, pay and check in on your page in their phone’s browser.

items.question: Can early bookers pay less?
items.answer: Yes, with dynamic pricing: the price steps up by an amount you set as seats fill, up to a maximum.

items.question: Can I bring my guest list from another tool?
items.answer: Yes. Import it from any tool before your next dinner.
